title: GH #87 bug 1: hold release scopes by {holder, cell, session}, not cell alone
action: BUGFIX, red-first: write the repro test and see it fail BEFORE the fix. In packages/bee/bee.mjs handleReservationsRelease (~1864-1882): the affected-cells derivation maps active local reservations to bare cell ids, then calls releaseHolds(topology.mainRoot, { holder, cell }) per cell — never passing session, even though releaseHolds (packages/bee/lib/worktree-holds.mjs:218, filter at :230) supports a session filter and the reserve side mirrors session onto the hold (bee.mjs:1799-1803, insertHold session: reserveResult.reservation.session || null). One session's release therefore clears a DIFFERENT session's still-active hold on the same cell id. Fix per issue #87's sample: derive {cell, session} PAIRS from the matched reservation rows (dedupe on cell::session), pass session into releaseHolds only when the row has one — a sessionless row keeps today's exact cell-only scoping. HOW A ROW GETS ITS SESSION (plan-checked, no discovery needed): --session flag on reservations reserve (bee.mjs:1762), else env BEE_SESSION_ID then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (packages/bee/lib/claims.mjs:147-160, flag wins), else single-live-session adoption; the projected reservation row carries the session key only when session_id is not the sessionless sentinel (packages/bee/lib/reservations.mjs:404), so r.session is undefined for legacy rows — that is the fallback discriminator. Test at CLI-handler level in packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs (reuse runBee/runModuleWorker ~:3359; mirrored-holds assertion precedent at :4880-4905 via findForeignHolds import at :32): two different agents reserve the SAME cell id under two DIFFERENT sessions; release one agent's reservation; assert only its session's hold released, the other session's hold survives; also assert sessionless-row fallback still clears cell-scoped — and STRIP ambient session env for that fixture ({ CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID/BEE_SESSION_ID dropped } idiom, hazard documented at test_bee_cli.mjs:837-846). ACCEPTED RESIDUAL (state in trace, do not fix): an agent holding both a sessionless row and a session-bearing row on one cell still clears every session's hold for that cell via the {cell, session:null} pair — inherent to the mandated fallback. REGEN OBLIGATION (repo law), run BEFORE the final verify so test_worktree_holds (which spawns the vendored .bee/bin/bee.mjs) sees the fix: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write. Commit regenerated files in the same cell commit.

truths: Releasing agent A's reservation on cell X under session S1 never releases a hold on cell X belonging to session S2.
A sessionless (legacy) reservation row falls back to cell-only hold scoping — byte-identical to today's behavior.
All existing test_bee_cli and test_reservations checks stay green.

prohibitions: No change to releaseHolds itself — the primitive is correct; the call site is the bug.
No product-file edits outside the two listed product files (regen outputs excepted).
